metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Chest Muscle Pain IN SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve chest muscle pain and tightness.

Pain in this area is usually caused by tightness that builds up in the pectoralis muscles (commonly called the pecs).

To fix this, this video will show you simple exercises to stretch these tight muscles, which may provide instant relief — even within 30 seconds.

Watch now and relieve chest muscle pain at home!

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/43coL2h
